1) Product Overview
Build a full functional, modern portfolio website for Ayush M. with a premium dark SaaS + founder vibe.
This portfolio must feel like it’s built by a senior engineer with 25 years experience: clean architecture, fast performance, strong UI, and production-ready.
This website will be deployed on Vercel, so everything must be Next.js compatible, optimized, and stable.

2) Primary Goal
Create a portfolio that positions Ayush as:
Entrepreneur / Builder
Product-minded creator
Finance + Tech + Systems thinker
AI Prompting + Automation developer
Not a “student portfolio”.
More like: startup founder’s personal site.

3) Target Audience
Startup founders
Recruiters (product + tech)
People interested in finance-tech products
Collaborators & early users

4) Brand & Tone
Personality Tone
Calm confidence
Minimal words, high clarity
Sharp and modern
Founder energy (not cringe motivational)
Visual Style
Dark premium SaaS UI
Deep navy / charcoal background
Accent: electric blue + soft green
Glassmorphism cards + soft glow borders
Smooth hover micro-interactions
Clean typography: Inter / Poppins

5) Core Pages & Sections (Must Have)
A) Home Page (Single Page Layout)
1. Navbar (Sticky)
Links:
Home
About
Skills
Projects
Work / Automation
Contact
Right side button:
“Contact”
Mobile:
Hamburger menu
2. Hero Section (High Impact)
Headline options (choose best):
“I build systems that compound.”
“Building products at the intersection of money + tech.”
“Founder mindset. Product execution.”
Sub-line: Ayush M — entrepreneur & product builder focused on technology, finance, AI and scalable systems.
Buttons:
View Projects
Contact Me
Extra:
Small “Currently building” badge: “Personal AI Voice Agent (in progress)”
B) About Section
Short, sharp and real.
Include:
Systems thinking
Long-term leverage mindset
Building products that connect logic + human behavior + money
C) Skills Section (Card Based, Not Bullets)
Each skill as premium cards:
AI Prompt Engineering Short description: Writing structured prompts to generate accurate outputs, product flows, scripts, and automation logic.
AI Automation (Basic → Working Systems) Short description: Built automations that deliver weekly financial insights directly to Gmail using connected data + AI analysis.
Finance + Product Strategy Short description: Understanding money flow, risk, compounding, incentives, and turning them into product systems.
Builder Mindset Short description: Fast MVPs, iteration, feedback loops, shipping.
D) Projects Section (Featured Cards + Detail Modal)
Each project must show:
Title
Status badge
One-line outcome
Tech tags (simple)
Buttons: Live / GitHub (if not available, show “Coming Soon”)
Projects List (Use Exactly)
1) Wealth Sprint
Status: Prototype
Link: https://wealthsprint.vercel.app
Description: A finance learning product that blends emotion + logic + real-world money decisions into an interactive system.
Role title (use this): ✅ Solo Product Designer & Builder
2) Money Tracker
Status: Live / MVP
Link: https://moneytrackerr.vercel.com
Description: Tracks income, expenses, debt, and cashflow — built to understand money movement clearly.
Role: ✅ Full-Stack Builder
3) Personal AI Voice Agent
Status: In Progress
Description: Voice-first AI assistant for productivity + workflows. (No fake claims, keep realistic.) Role: ✅ Builder
4) No Longer Friends But Not Strangers Yet
Status: In Progress
Type: Book / Writing project
Description: A Hinglish writing project exploring emotional distance, connection, and human behavior. Role: ✅ Author
E) “Automation / Systems” Section (Unique Differentiator)
Title: “Automation & Systems I Build”
Include 2–3 cards:
Weekly Financial Data Analysis → Gmail
Prompt-based productivity workflows
AI-driven tracking systems mindset
Keep it minimal but powerful.
F) Contact Section (Functional)
Contact form fields:
Name
Email
Message
Button: Send Message
Must include direct email: 📩 ayushxma@gmail.com
Functional requirement:
Form should work using Formspree OR simple mailto: fallback
Must show success / error states

6) Functional Requirements (Must)
Fully responsive (mobile-first)
Smooth scrolling navigation
SEO optimized (title, meta, OpenGraph)
Fast loading (Lighthouse friendly)
Clean component structure
Animations should be subtle (Framer Motion allowed)
Deployable to Vercel without errors

7) Tech Stack Requirements (For Vercel)
Must generate using:
Next.js (App Router)
TypeScript preferred
TailwindCSS preferred
No heavy unnecessary libraries
Optional but good:
Framer Motion
Lucide Icons

8) Pages / Routes (Preferred)
/ → main portfolio (single-page sections) Optional:
/projects → full project list (if generated)

9) UI Components (Must Look Premium)
Glass cards with border glow
Gradient text for name “Ayush M”
Badges for status (Prototype / Live / In Progress)
Project cards with hover lift + shadow
Minimal footer

10) Copywriting Rules
No cringe motivational quotes
No “I am passionate about coding since childhood”
More: “I build systems, ship MVPs, iterate.”

11) Footer
Text: © 2026 Ayush M. Built with intent, not noise.

12) Deliverables Output Format (IMPORTANT)
Generate the complete project as:
Full Next.js codebase structure
Components separated cleanly
Ready for npm install && npm run dev
Ready to deploy on Vercel
Include:
README with deployment steps
Environment variables only if needed (avoid them if possible)

**Conceptualizing The Portfolio**

I'm solidifying the aesthetic direction for Ayush's portfolio. The plan is a dark SaaS brand with navy and charcoal as the core, accented by electric blue and soft green. Visually, I'm leaning toward glassmorphism with subtle animations and clean typography using Inter/Poppins. It will be designed mobile-first.


**Structuring the Application**

I've outlined the core sections of the portfolio: Navbar, Hero, About, Skills, Projects, Automation, Contact, and Footer. The tech stack will be React, built with Vite and following React 18+ guidelines to create a high-quality React SPA, with features like Framer Motion, Lucide Icons, responsiveness, and form handling via Formspree. I'm focusing on well-structured code, including components, types, and constants. The plan is to build components like Navbar with a sticky glass effect, Hero with a "Currently building" badge, About with concise copy, Skills with premium cards, and Projects with grid layout and status badges.


**Implementing Core Elements**

I'm now focusing on core components like automation cards, the contact form, and the minimalist footer. I've defined the background as a very dark navy/charcoal, with glass effects achieved via `backdrop-blur-md` and white borders. Accent colors are set to electric blue and soft green. The hero headline will be "I build systems that compound." I have the skill descriptions and project list ready. I will use Framer Motion for animation and Lucide icons for a clean aesthetic. Smooth scrolling will be achieved with CSS. I am still keeping in mind the discrepancy between the prompt's request for Next.js and the system instructions' requirement for a React SPA, so I will ensure that the resulting app is designed to align with the System Instructions.


**Defining the Site Structure**

I've got the project structure mapped out, focusing on a clean and maintainable React application. I'm aiming for that "Senior Engineer" feel using dark grays, subtle gradients, and precise spacing. I'm planning to use animations for a subtle, professional feel, with `initial` and `whileInView` properties, and a hover scale effect for interactive elements. I am excited to write the code.
